item.description: Why is KUAC making these changes?KUAC is facing a funding gap of $1.2 million, amounting to one-third of the station’s annual operating budget. item.title: Spring Brings Seasonal Sun Outages
item.description: Our station will be experiencing brief sun outages for the next week. This phenomenon happens twice a year around the equinox as the sun passes directly behind the satellites that supply KUAC’s signal. The outages should be brief, 1 to 10 minutes at the most. Thank you for listening and for your patience!
